description: This Java interface defines a repository for CustomerEntity objects, providing database access methods such as find, count, and custom queries related to customers in the system.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for CustomerEntity, providing methods for querying customer data from the database.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of CustomerEntity objects filtered by tenant ID and optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTitle
methods.description: Finds a CustomerEntity by tenant ID and customer title.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns a list of EntityInfo objects for customers with names starting with a given prefix.

methods.name: findPublicCustomerByTenantId
methods.description: Finds a public customer for a given tenant ID.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts the number of customers associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves the external ID associated with a customer by customer ID.

methods.name: findCustomersWithTheSameTitle
methods.description: Finds customers with duplicate titles within tenants, paginated.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of CustomerFields starting after a specific customer ID.

methods.name: findCustomersByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds customers by tenant ID and a list of customer IDs.
